script:
set -u
umask 077
trap 'rm -f /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa.s /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa.r /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.dll /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.runtimeconfig.json /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-request.json' EXIT
exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/5678 || exit 80
(
set -eu
test "$(id -u)" = 901
if [ ! -x /usr/bin/dotnet ]; then
  printf '%s\n' AEROTIZEN_SDK_DOTNET_UNAVAILABLE
  exit 127
fi
printf '%s  %s\n' 0343b13708cd52d33ecbb1043b5ae145e73a532bdccf7de6925db5cce6054fd3 /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.dll | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
printf '%s  %s\n' 44136fa355b3678a1146ad16f7e8649e94fb4fc21fe77e8310c060f61caaff8a /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.runtimeconfig.json | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
printf '%s  %s\n' 44136fa355b3678a1146ad16f7e8649e94fb4fc21fe77e8310c060f61caaff8a /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-request.json | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
/usr/bin/dotnet /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.dll /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-request.json
) >&3 2>&3
result=$?
rm -f /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa.s /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa.r /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.dll /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-Query.runtimeconfig.json /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/ah-aaaaaaaaaaaa-request.json || exit 81
printf '\nAEROTIZEN_SDK_CLEANED\nAEROTIZEN_SDK_EXIT=%s\n' "$result" >&3
exec 3>&-
exit "$result"
